title: FAQ Public Page — server component page.tsx with metadata
content:
Create the public FAQ page at `/[locale]/faq`.

Server component that:
1. `generateMetadata`: uses `dict.faqPage.pageTitle` + `dict.faqPage.pageDescription` per locale
2. Page component:
   - Resolves `locale` from `params`
   - Gets `dict` via `getDictionary(locale)`
   - Fetches data from `GET ${baseUrl}/api/faq` with `fetch(..., { cache: "no-store" })`
   - Renders `<Breadcrumbs currentLocale={locale} items={[faq]} dict={dict.breadcrumbs} />`
   - Renders `<FAQAccordion categories={data.categories} dict={dict.faqPage} locale={locale} />`
   - Each category item uses locale-aware field selection (e.g., `question${localeSuffix}`)
3. Follows existing public page patterns (About, Contact, Terms pages)

API response shape (from AF-001-D):
```
{ categories: [{ category: { id, nameZh, nameEn, nameZhCn }, items: [{ id, questionZh, questionEn, questionZhCn, answerZh, answerEn, answerZhCn, order }] }] }
```

Locale suffix mapping:
- `en` → use `*En` fields
- `zh-hk` → use `*Zh` fields
- `zh-cn` → use `*ZhCn` fields

No inline error/loading/empty handling — those are delegated to FAQAccordion (AF-003-B).
acceptance: GET /[locale]/faq loads and shows categorized FAQs
Page title and meta description set per locale (dict.faqPage)
Locale-aware field selection works for en, zh-hk, zh-cn
API fetch uses no-store (fresh data every request)
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
Visit /en/faq, /zh-hk/faq, /zh-cn/faq — all render with correct locale text
files: src/app/[locale]/faq/page.tsx (new — public FAQ page server component)
